findingsResolvedDuringReview.problem: Kind-based grid occupancy accepted an ITEM span restoration that overlapped a same-row BODY button
findingsResolvedDuringReview.originalReproduction: Both full states were valid: current item1-6 plus button7-12; baseline item1-8 plus button9-12. Selecting only item span6-to8 was previously accepted.
findingsResolvedDuringReview.resolution: The implementation rejects arbitrary mixed rows and permits only known numeric trailing button rows with fresh-row/fresh-column flags; coupled mixed rows also remain manual

findingsResolvedDuringReview.problem: Actual native ITEM parent parameter p_item_plug_id was omitted, hiding region moves and merging unrelated region grids
findingsResolvedDuringReview.originalReproduction: The actual baseline P1_PROJECT parent parsed as #NULL#. Changing its real parent plus span produced CHANGED/Y instead of CONFLICT/N.
findingsResolvedDuringReview.resolution: Recognize the actual parent parameter, use it for component identity/grouping, and exclude it as a standalone layout scalar

findingsResolvedDuringReview.problem: Actual p_button_template_id and p_region_template_options parameter names were missing from semantic detection
findingsResolvedDuringReview.originalReproduction: Changing three actual button-template references yielded no changed rows before the correction
findingsResolvedDuringReview.resolution: Recognize actual component aliases, map the button reference to BUTTON_TEMPLATE, and retain detection-only handling; region display point and observed extra theme defaults are also recognized

hygiene.limits: Pattern-based public text scan only; this independent phase does not certify binary media or all possible secret formats and does not replace the release provenance/history scan

remainingScopeLimits: No additional concrete release blocker was found in the final recorded code bytes after the verified corrections.
No general mixed-grid, responsive CSS, visual equivalence or arbitrary theme proof is claimed.
Application navigation-list settings remain explicitly outside this beta's semantic-comparison scope.
Template constructors and name/class aliases lacking real embedded export bodies have unit-model evidence only.
Prior history/import-failure/browser runs have separate evidence. This phase did not repeat their application mutations or claim their full coverage.
Public import can commit or fail partially; trusted artifacts, coordinated maintenance and explicit owner recovery remain required.
Only the recorded Oracle/APEX environment is covered; this is not an exhaustive security audit or a final release-commit certification.
verdict: No remaining concrete release-blocking finding in the independently verified final delta, within the documented beta scope.
